item.title: MG Pavilion In BGC Now In Full Swing With Special Christmas, New Year Events
item.description: The MG Brand Pavilion at Bonifacio Global City is now in full swing, welcoming thousands of visitors daily since its opening—and the experience is only getting better. Running until January 2026, the Pavilion continues to offer an exciting lineup of activities, rewards, and immersive brand engagements designed to showcase the best of MG’s global innovation, design, and mobility solutions.Read More »

item.title: Hyundai Motor PH Is FIFA Futsal Women Teams Mobility Partner
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) strengthened its long-standing partnership with the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) through a turnover of Vehicles-in-Kind (VIK) to help mobilize the delegation and officials of the first-ever FIFA Futsal Women's World Cup event hosted in the Philippines from November 21 to December 7, 2025.Read More »

item.title: Porsche 911 GT3 Now Available At Porsche Philippines
item.description: Porsche Philippines is now making the latest 911 GT3 (992.2) available at Porsche Centers nationwide. Built on a strong motorsports pedigree, the 911 GT3 has recorded the fastest lap ever achieved by a production car with a manual transmission, completing the Nürburgring-Nordschleife’s 20.832-kilometer lap in 6 minutes and 56.294 seconds.Read More »

item.title: Toyota Reports 45 Percent Growth In Electrified Vehicle Sales So Far In 2025
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines reports a 45 percent year-on-year growth when it comes to their electrified vehicle sales. Sales of Toyota and Lexus brands combined showed a total of 16,986 “xEV” sold as of end November.Read More »
